question: Who among the following Indian dancers was the first woman in Indian history to be nominated as a member of the Rajya Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rukmini Devi Arundale**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Parliamentary form of government consists of three parts: The president, The Rajya Sabha (Council of States or the upper house) and the Lok Sabha (House of People or the lower house).
 
• The Rajya Sabha has a fixed 250 members of maximum out of which **238 are the representatives of the states and UTs elected indirectly** and 12 are nominated by the president.
 
• **Classical Bharatnatyam dancer from Tamil Nadu, Rukmini Devi Arundale became the first woman in India to be nominated as a member of the Rajya Sabha in 1952. Hence option 1 is correct.**
 
 
• **​She was honoured with Padma Bhushan in 1956** and Sangeet Natak Academy Fellowship in 1967.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Madhuri Dixit** is an Indian actress who works in Hindi films and acted in over 70 movies.

 
 
• ​She has featured in Forbes India's Celebrities 100 list and was **honoured with Padma Sri in 2008.**
 
 
 
• **Mallika Sarabhai is an Indian classical dancer in Kuchipudi and Bharatnatyam** from Gujarat and is the daughter of classical dancer Mrinalini Sarabhai and Vikram Sarabhai, who is considered a father of Indian Space program.
 
 
• **​In 2010, she was honoured with Padma Bhushan**.
 
 
 
• **Saroj Khan was an Indian dancer and choreographer** who worked in Hindi films and was the **first to be honoured with Filmfare best choreography award.**
 
• Currently, there are 245 members of the Rajya Sabha out of which 229 members represent the states.
 
• The representatives of states are elected by the elected members of the state legislative assembly and the representatives of UTs are indirectly elected by the members of the electoral college of the UT.
